original_method: Map VIN_Mgmt and VIN_Bulk sources to each PMIC and I2C address; prove railtype5 and voltage comparators; resolve severity; baseline input-select/status and downstream rails; inject one tuple with live telemetry; correlate fresh VIN_Mgmt-specific evidence; assert the approved reset/no-reset and switchover/no-switchover result; restore state and validate memory before another target.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure calls the injection Fatal while Criteria calls it correctable and gives no reset/no-reset rule. All DIMMs and voltage types0/1 are requested from one fixed tuple, command continuation is ambiguous, and railtype5/input-selection/comparator semantics are undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: VIN management-input testing and the literal seed tuple are identifiable. Engineering can resolve severity and input-path acceptance, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 94 Wistron-System RAS-00814-V002: prove railtype5=VIN_Mgmt Input Only and define voltagetype0/1; reconcile Fatal procedure label with correctable Criteria and specify reset/no-reset plus switchover/no-switchover behavior; map every DIMM/PMIC to VIN_Mgmt/VIN_Bulk sources, socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, PMIC address and Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/OOB path; approve command/tuple matrix, electrical limits, PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence, OS timeout, memory recovery, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds explicit input selection and negative switchover evidence while surfacing the fatal-versus-correctable conflict and incomplete all-DIMM matrix.
independent_technical_reasoning: An input-only case is defined by which PMIC supply remains selected, not simply by an error log. The adjacent railtype6 case exists specifically for management-to-bulk transfer, so unintended switchover here must be observable and treated according to an approved rule. Because the source simultaneously says Fatal and correctable, safe execution and the expected reset outcome cannot be inferred from the command alone.
